t: An $(l:bigreactors/active)actively cooled$(/l) Reactor/Turbine setup vaporizes a coolant using the heat of the Reactor to generate vapor that can be used to drive the rotors of many Turbines and generate energy.$(br2)A $(bold)coolant$() is a fluid that, if recognized, can be pumped into the Coolant Fluid Tank of the Reactor using a $(l:bigreactors/part-forgefluidport)Fluid Port$(/l) in input mode.
$(l:bigreactors/active)主动冷却$(/l)反应堆/涡轮机装置会利用反应堆产生的热量将冷却液汽化，生成可用于驱动多个涡轮机转子的蒸汽，并以此发电。$(br2)$(bold)冷却液$()是一种流体，只要被识别为有效冷却液，就可以通过设为输入模式的 $(l:bigreactors/part-forgefluidport)流体端口$(/l) 泵入反应堆的冷却液流体储罐中。

A $(bold)vapor$() is a fluid that is the result of a coolant being vaporized inside a Reactor, and it can be pumped from a Reactor to a Turbine (using $(l:bigreactors/part-forgefluidport)Fluid Port$(/l)) to drive the Turbine rotor and then be condensed back to the original coolant, allowing the cycle to start again.$(br2)Only valid coolants and vapors can be used inside a Reactor or a Turbine.
$(bold)蒸汽$()是一种流体，是冷却液在反应堆内部汽化后的产物。它可以通过 $(l:bigreactors/part-forgefluidport)流体端口$(/l) 从反应堆输送到涡轮机，以驱动涡轮机转子，之后再冷凝回原本的冷却液，让整个循环重新开始。$(br2)只有有效的冷却液和蒸汽才能在反应堆或涡轮机内部使用。
Extreme Reactors register, by default, water as a valid coolant and steam as its resulting vapor.$(br2)Other mods or mod packs can add their own fluids or modify/remove the default ones.
Extreme Reactors 默认将水注册为有效冷却液，并将蒸汽注册为其对应产物。$(br2)其他模组或整合包可以添加自己的流体，或修改/移除默认流体。
